steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hey, Jessica, where you going?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I need to go find him—
Jessica?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Franka? Laura?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Reporting in. I've confirmed Jessica's location. She was, in fact, at said diner, and her lips are currently covered in oil. Best guess is that she's been getting acquainted with the menu.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Understood. I'm just about finished on my end as well.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Took you long enough, Teacher's Pet. We were starving out here.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It was hard to find this place. It's in the middle of nowhere.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, whatever. Let's just find something to tide us over.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Miss, I'm extremely grateful you brought Miles home, but if you're gonna complain about my cooking, that's a different matter.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Complain? What's there to complain about in this weather? Isn't that right, Laura?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: O-Of course, it's absolutely delicious! Better than anything my mom or grandma ever made, that's for sure!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Good to hear there are still folks out there who appreciate the craft! So what do they do for a living, sweetie? Are they cooks?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Umm, my mom's a doctor, and my grandma's an engineer. Neither of them know their way around a kitchen... so my dad did all the cooking.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Pffffft... Ahahahahahahaha!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hey. Don't you think you're enjoying that a little too much?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: *cough*... Whoa, easy there! I'm eating, see? I'm eating!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Excuse me... Ma'am, do you have anything to drink? I'd like a glass of water.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Sure thing, just a moment.
Picking up a random empty glass on the table, the restaurant owner throws open the window and scoops up a cupful of thick snow.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Give it a bit to melt, and then it'll be drinkable.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: By the way, Captain, did you ever find out why we met up with someone from the bank?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The government here is barely functional and doesn't have the capacity to interface with us, so they left the matter entirely to the bank.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: They left it to who?! Well, what did the folks at the bank say?

spans.text: ?! Well, what did the folks at the bank say?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It roughly boils down to two things: We'll have their full support, and the details will be discussed at a later date.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Tch, sounds like we've got our work cut out for us. But you're not the type to come here to eat your sorrows away, right?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: They're lacking in supplies and manpower, but they do have money.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Money's the one thing we're not short on, though. That said... assuming the bank keeps their word, what do you think about hiring on a few of the locals?

spans.text: short on, though. That said... assuming the bank keeps their word, what do you think about hiring on a few of the locals?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Ever since the power plant incident, most of the people on this plate have chosen to leave. It's hard to say how many able-bodied workers are left.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That explains how few lights are on outside. It's barely eight o'clock!

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: To be honest, we don't need that many people either. I can handle the repair work with just my team. What we really need is someone with a deep understanding of the situation in the energy tower. Is the bank offering any good candidates?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: About that... * cough*, *cough*.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I was so busy fixing up your communicator that I forgot to introduce myself.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: The name's Leone Theremin, a blast engineer from the local mine. Pleased to meet ya.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: A blast engineer from the mine... Why are you still here, after all this time?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hah, a few of us stubborn old farts refused to leave. I've been in this mine since I was four. Wouldn't know how to live anywhere else.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: When the plant first started having problems back then, I took a team down there to deal with it. Though we never managed to fix it entirely, we did get it up and running for a while.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm impressed. It's still working to this day.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Eh, that's all in the past now. Nothing worth mentioning. But, how would I be paid for this exactly...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Oh, that... The commission's supposed to be completed ASAP, so we're not paid per diem. Only the required room and board expenses are covered.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: After the plant is repaired, we'll be paid in a lump sum. The faster we get it done, the bigger the reward.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Of course, we can also offer you a portion of the payment in advance, in the interest of cooperation.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: And how much are we talking here?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You'll be treated as a consultant. If we can get the job done in two months, you'll get 40,000. In a month, twice that. In a week—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Twice that again?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: A bit more than that. You'll be able to earn yourself a solid 200 grand.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Deal!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Didn't even think twice, huh?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I ain't turning down 200 grand.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Sure, but where would you even spend that kind of cash here?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Depends how old you are. For a young guy, 200 grand is enough to eat, drink, and play to your heart's content, but when you're my age it's just another drop in the bucket called debt.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Debt? Are you in debt?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Not just me. Everyone left here is in debt. *sigh*... How do I put this? Well, I'll just give it to you straight.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You asked about a guy who walked out into the snowfield earlier, right? It's probably 'cause of his debts... That kinda stuff happens all the time here. After being forced into bankruptcy, he had no choice but to...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Walk straight into the snowfield, with nothing on him...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...What are the odds he's still alive? I knew I should've stopped him. If we go looking for him right now, can we still save him?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: *sigh*... That ain't even worth thinking about. It's too late.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's not your fault, Jessica.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Ahem. So, Laura, is there anything you'd like to discuss with Mr. Theremin?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Oh, right... Come back here tomorrow to meet up with us, sir. If you have any materials, bring them with you too.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Alright, no problem. I know a few miners too, and they can also—

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: That won't be necessary. You're enough.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Don't be like that. Can't hurt to recruit a few more. Put yourself in our shoes. All the able-bodied folks are gone, and the only people left are...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Old farts like me.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Thanks for coming to see me, Benny. I'll be fine though, so head on home. Stay out any later, and Leone's gonna be worried sick about you again.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: I still haven't finished my writing exercises... Besides, I don't want to go home. Dad is... Never mind.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I know Leone's got a bit of a temper, but even after all these years, his feelings for you have never—

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: I understand all that, but...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: *sigh*... You warm enough? Should I throw a few more logs onto the fire?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Don't worry, it's fine... By the way, about those people who brought you home today. Was that the same Blacksteel squad that rescued you?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Yup. They're here to help us fix the energy tower. When it's all up and running and the heat's working again, we won't even need this fireplace.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: But even if the tower can be fixed up... That doesn't mean the plate will come back to life.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: ...You're gonna go bald early if you keep worrying about crap like that.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Someone has to worry about it, because Dad sure won't. And who else is going to? There was Carl, but he's gone now too.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Benny...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Miles! Are you there, Miles? Thank goodness, I found us a great job! We can fix up the power plant and make piles of cash while we're at it!

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Dad? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Oh, you were here, Benny?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Well, you can stay and keep studying. I need to take Miles to go meet those Blacksteel girls—

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I already met them. They're the ones who rescued me.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hah, me and my memory.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Did you already ask the others?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...I asked all over town. They're either already gone, getting ready to leave, or have given up altogether.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You and I are the only ones still willing to put in the work on that plant.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The safe house isn't expected to be completely ready for use until tomorrow night, so we'll be establishing this as our temporary rendezvous point.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Laura, as of tomorrow, the engineering team will be under your command. We must restore this plate's mobility as soon as possible.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: No problemo.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: As for Franka and Jessica, I have some odd jobs for the two of you. I need one person to come with me to pay the bank another visit. And the other...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Needs to head to the outskirts of the plate to make a security assessment. Employees from the bank have said that bandits occasionally come from out there.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: C-Can I volunteer to head to the outskirts?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Sure, why not? Which means I'll be going with ol' Liskarm here to see just how big of a headache these bank people are gonna be.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Everyone, please note that while most of the tower is basically safe due to the active Originium dust settling down over a long period of time, there are still areas where the index exceeds standard values.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I've already synced your devices with the specific danger zones.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: This will be a hot repair, as the tower is still in operation, albeit at low output. So please pay attention to your personal safety, and report any accidents ASAP.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Thanks, you two. You saved us a lot of time poking around at the danger zones one by one.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I've worked here for most of my life. This place's more my home than that crappy room in the underpass.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Then sorry in advance for making a bit of a mess.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Wouldn't have it any other way.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Gah—!

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: ...It's so badly damaged, but it's still burning? This is practically a miracle.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Miles and I reinforced the furnace a few years back, both to prevent accidents and to let it burn things other than Originium fuel.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Heh. The first time a winter like this struck, we still had some leftover Originium products lying around. But later we were lucky to have wood to burn.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: As for now... all we can do is assess the situation.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Team A is in place. Everyone else, report your location and status. We'll begin diagnostics in one minute.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Team B in place. Visual inspection shows approximately thirty percent damage to the combined cycle unit.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Team C in place. The cooling system is completely wrecked, but since it's so cold outside we can throw together a makeshift air-cooling system.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Team D in place. The ash-discharging airduct is operating normally. We'll adjust our pace depending on the other teams' needs.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Well then, everyone—

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: —Let's get to work.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Captain, I've arrived at the last patrol point.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Any sign of bandits along the way?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... I drove all the way out here without seeing anything.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka and I will be entering talks with the bank shortly. Be careful.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you encounter any problems, contact us immediately. Don't worry about inconveniencing us. Do you understand?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Roger that.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Helena said that Woodrow often passes by here after hunting... I don't know if I'll be able to meet him today.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Why does it... smell like pine oil here?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Pine branches... Did someone start a fire?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Someone's been through here, but who? Could it be Woodrow coming back to the plate?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *huff*... W-Woodrow, wait for me!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Someone else is back there...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Woodrow, watch out!

steps.name: Sneaky Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Who's there?! Well shit, you've brought more bad news.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...What are you doing here?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir, there might be bandits roaming in the area. You should head back to safety on the plate as soon as you can.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um, why do you look so angry?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You sure know how to be a pain in the rear.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But that man behind you just tried to snipe you... I came here to save you...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You have any idea how hard it was to lure that guy out? And now, all that evidence is down the drain, thanks to your bullet.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: O-Oh no... Sorry, I...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: A-Are you investigating something? Maybe I can help you somehow, to make up for it?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Okay, now that you know there are bandits out here, ever thought about what they might be after?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Probably looting supplies... Since it's tough getting by around here?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: We can barely keep ourselves fed and clothed on the plate. You think they want our scraps? Their M.O. is to ambush and rob caravans.

spans.text: fed and clothed on the plate. You think they want our scraps? Their M.O. is to ambush and rob caravans.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th-Then, what are they after here?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Lately, a bunch of people from the plate have gone missing. And my witnesses tell me some of 'em have been seen talking to bandits here before they vanished...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: So my question to you is this: what're you doing here?

spans.text: So my question to you is this: what're

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I was assigned to maintain security along the plate's outskirts, and ensure that any bandits wandering the perimeter don't interfere with the power plant's repair.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: All on your lonesome?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... I have teammates. Besides, aren't you also here?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Whatever. Bye.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wait! The bullet—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh, he's already gone...
